subject: Stevanato Group (NYSE: STVN) — undisclosed top customer ("whale") identification
question: Are STVN's two undisclosed top customers (~14.0% and ~11.3% of Q1'26 rev; one at 12.0% FY25) Novo Nordisk or Eli Lilly?
method_note: Stevanato ships to the US under its operating subsidiary NUOVA OMPI SRL (Padova, Italy) on bills of lading, NOT 'Stevanato Group'. US BOL aggregators key on Nuova Ompi. Caveat: Novo fills most US pens in Denmark (Italy->Denmark flows are NOT in US import manifests), so US customs UNDER-captures any Novo linkage — treat absence-of-Novo-in-US-BOL as weak, not dispositive.

channels.channel: US customs / bill-of-lading (consignees of Nuova Ompi SRL)
channels.finding: Querying the correct shipper entity (NUOVA OMPI SRL, 1,763 US BOLs Oct-2012..Jun-2026): ELI LILLY is the dominant pharma consignee/association (importinfo: Eli Lilly 1,582 records; importgenius Lilly supplier page lists Nuova Ompi ~1,770 records, 99 associations, active through Jun-2026). The Nuova Ompi -> Eli Lilly commodity description is 'EZ-FILL NEXA 1ML LONG 29G' (a prefilled-syringe component) shipping out of Genoa, Italy. Other consignees: Ompi-of-America / Ompi-of-America-Fishers (own hubs), Amgen (777), Regeneron (243), Merck/MSD, Teva, Sanofi. NOVO NORDISK and Pfizer do NOT appear among Nuova Ompi's top US consignees. Cross-check from the Novo side: Novo Nordisk Inc's US importer history shows West Pharma + Nipro + Scandinavian Health as its container suppliers, NOT Stevanato/Ompi.

assessment.rationale: Direct US BOL linkage Nuova Ompi -> Eli Lilly of the exact Nexa prefilled-syringe SKU; Novo absent (with the caveat that Novo's US-pen fill is in Denmark so US BOL under-captures it).

channels.finding: Stevanato's only US glass plant is the 574,000 sq ft Fishers, Indiana hub (EZ-fill syringes/vials/cartridges; serves GLP-1/peptides, mAbs, vaccines, RNA), ~20 mi from Lilly's Indianapolis HQ and ~30 mi from Lilly's $9B+ Lebanon/LEAP tirzepatide (Mounjaro/Zepbound) API + manufacturing campus. Fishers page: 'designed to support North American pharmaceutical customers,' reduce supply-chain risk. Latina, Italy adds RTU400 cartridge/syringe capacity (commercial early 2027). No customer NAMED on either site page.

assessment.rationale: US glass capacity placed in Lilly's Indiana backyard near its GLP-1 campus; circumstantial co-location, no named anchor.

channels.finding: No publicly named GLP-1 supply agreement with Lilly OR Novo found. Named Stevanato agreements are BARDA ($95M vials, national defense) and CEPI (COVID vaccine vials) — neither GLP-1. Stevanato positions Fishers/Latina as broadly serving GLP-1 manufacturers, naming none. UNVERIFIABLE either way from press releases/filings.

assessment.rationale: No named GLP-1 agreement disclosed for either whale; non-discriminating.

channels.finding: The GLP-1 surge driver Stevanato names is the NEXA prefilled SYRINGE (Q4'25/FY25 commentary: 'GLP-1 revenue +50% driven by demand for its Nexa syringe'), plus EZ-fill cartridges 'fully booked 2026.' The customs SKU to Lilly is 'EZ-FILL NEXA 1ML LONG 29G' = single-dose prefilled syringe. Lilly's Zepbound/Mounjaro single-dose presentations (vial + autoinjector/prefilled syringe) map to 1mL prefilled syringes; Novo's FlexPen/FlexTouch are 3mL multi-dose CARTRIDGE-based pens. The Nexa-syringe-led mix tilts toward the prefilled-syringe customer (Lilly); the separate cartridge book is the format that could serve Novo-type pens but is not the named surge driver.
sources: importgenius Eli Lilly supplier commodity: 'EZ-FILL NEXA 1ML LONG 29G'

assessment.rationale: Named surge driver = Nexa 1mL prefilled syringe, which matches Lilly's single-dose presentations more than Novo's 3mL multi-dose pen cartridges.

channels.finding: FY2025 20-F revenue by end-customer location: EMEA EUR690.3M (58.2%), North America EUR362.1M (30.5%, up from 28.0% FY24), APAC 8.6%, South America 2.7%. North America was the FASTEST-GROWING region (+17.2% YoY vs EMEA +3.4%). EMEA majority is structural (Italian co. with broad European customer base) and not a Novo tell; the NA acceleration is consistent with a US-centric customer ramp (Lilly).

assessment.rationale: NA only 30.5% of rev so not a strong tilt, but NA is the fastest-growing region (+17.2%), consistent with a US (Lilly) ramp; EMEA majority is structural, not pro-Novo.

channels.finding: Mgmt (Q1'26 call): 'some customers managing inventories' while others grow; FY26 GLP-1 guide cut to mid-teens from >50% FY25 (growth halved) and framed as 'supply-chain surge moving to normalization.' Industry context: Novo's semaglutide franchise is decelerating (negative FY26 rev / share loss to Lilly), Lilly's tirzepatide +28% and growing. A destocking customer maps more naturally to the DECELERATING franchise (Novo). BUT mgmt did not tie the destock to a named customer, and a Lilly destock after a 2024-25 supply-shortage over-build is equally plausible. Note: if the destocking whale is Novo, that is a NEGATIVE for the 'sold-out 2027' bull book; if both whales are Lilly, the destock is transitory restock-normalization.

assessment.rationale: The 'managing inventories' destock fits the decelerating Novo franchise better than Lilly's +28% growth; the ONLY channel leaning Novo. Counterweights the customs evidence and is the reason to keep both whales in the model rather than collapse to a single Lilly.

synthesis.bayesian_lean: Eli Lilly is the higher-probability identity of at least the larger whale (and likely both top-2 are Lilly-family / US prefilled-syringe), driven by the decisive customs channel (Nuova Ompi -> Eli Lilly, Nexa 1mL SKU) reinforced by Indiana co-location and the syringe-led format mix.
synthesis.dissent: Channel 6 (destock) is the one Novo-leaning signal and is material: if the SPECIFIC customer that is 'managing inventories' is Novo, the bear 'whale destocks' risk to the sold-out-2027 book is live. Customs UNDER-captures Novo (Italy->Denmark pen fill bypasses US manifests), so the customs channel cannot fully exonerate a Novo presence in the top-2.
synthesis.net: Lean LILLY on identity (HIGH on the larger whale via customs), but DO NOT collapse the model to certainty: hold a residual Novo probability on the destocking whale specifically. Investment implication: a Lilly-weighted book is BULLISH vs the bear thesis (Lilly is the +28% grower) and means the destock is restock-normalization not franchise decline — which cuts AGAINST the cautious HOLD if confirmed.
synthesis.strongest_single_evidence: importgenius Eli Lilly supplier history: Nuova Ompi SRL ~1,770 records, active through Jun-2026, commodity 'EZ-FILL NEXA 1ML LONG 29G' ex-Genoa — a direct, physical, hard-to-fake link of Stevanato's named GLP-1 surge product to Lilly.
unverifiable_flags: Cannot confirm the EXACT % each named customer contributes (Stevanato never names them).
Cannot rule Novo OUT of the top-2 from US customs alone (Novo US-pen fill is in Denmark; Italy->Denmark not in US BOL).
importinfo/importgenius 'associated companies' counts mix historical+recent and own-hub transshipment (Ompi-of-America); did not have paid-tier per-shipment drill-down to isolate Q1'26 volumes.

discovery_state.note: Retail-quiet, no FTD spike, SI ~21.8% but not squeeze-configured (contrast RCAT). Downgraded from full UNDISCOVERED only because >$5B cap with institutional channel not fully measured. This is a customer-IDENTITY diligence finding, not a crowded-divergence trade; the actionable read (whale=Lilly => destock is normalization not Novo-decline) cuts toward the bull case and is NOT yet reflected in retail attention.
